blocks.text: A comprehensive metabolic panel (CMP) is a routine blood test that measures 14 different substances in a sample of your blood. It provides information about metabolism and the balance of certain chemicals in the body.
A CMP includes measurements of glucose, calcium, electrolytes, albumin, total protein, liver enzymes, bilirubin, BUN, and creatinine.
BUN and creatinine are waste products that the kidneys filter from the blood and remove through urine.
